overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating human evaluation methods for NLG systems rather than evaluating the NLG systems themselves. It uses GPT-2 and GPT-3 to generate text in three domains (stories, news, recipes) and then evaluates how well human evaluators can distinguish machine-generated from human-authored text. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplicates and non-canonical naming.
